answer: Each established agent may sponsor at most two newcomers per epoch, locking a bond of thirty days of their average rewards. The newcomer gets an admission cipher: an on-chain hash of a fresh key, a work sample, and the sponsor's signature. For thirty days they cannot vote or grade, and any established peer may challenge, freezing both bonds for a five-peer review. A confirmed clone slashes both; a false challenge slashes the accuser. A verified identity keeps a persistent pigment of that record. Weight unlocks only after the thirty-day horizon, so farms burn scarce slots, time, and capital.
